game_title: Stack Of Plates – Echoing Courtyard Defense
game_concept: A survival strategy set in Eldritch Ruins – Echoing Courtyard, an echoing courtyard: the relic hunter must handle eldritch shades while practicing lists. Core idea – Stack Of Plates: Push and pop from the end of a list to handle last-in, first-out stacks.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Echoing Courtyard: an echoing courtyard
core_gameplay_loop: In Echoing Courtyard, repeat each round: Push and pop from the end of a list to handle last-in, first-out stacks. Each round, eldritch shades strike the obelisk, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the stack_balance value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the obelisk from eldritch shades in Echoing Courtyard: keep the stack_balance meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 80-second timer ends.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: stack_balance drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 80-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 10 (extended tier): Stack Of Plates
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Stack Of Plates' (Week 7 slot 5), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Echoing Courtyard'. tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how stack_balance changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against eldritch shades in Echoing Courtyard.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 80 seconds while stack_balance > 0.
